about: Whether two names are the same channel beyond reasonable doubt.
notes: The identifying words as a multiset, so word order does not matter but an extra word does. This is deliberately stricter than the similarity score: it decides whether a channel is switched to without asking.

cases.name: differing only in a quality word
differing only in word order
cases.why: Providers order words differently and mean the same channel.

cases.name: differing only in a feed qualifier
a regional variant is not the same channel
cases.why: This pair scores high enough under the subset rule to be switched to silently, which is exactly what must not happen.

cases.name: a different number is a different channel
a name with no identifying words matches nothing
cases.why: Two names that both reduce to nothing are not thereby the same channel.
